tasks.InsuranceCost: 10% of the total cost (material + construction) to get it insured.
tasks.JewelerConstructionCost: The cost Janet paid for the jeweler to construct the brooch.
tasks.MaterialCost: The cost of the material Janet bought for the brooch.
tasks.TotalAmountPaid: The sum of MaterialCost, JewelerConstructionCost, and InsuranceCost.
